blocks.content: Quiz: Suppose the id is an integer, name is a string, and age is an integer.
Which of the following SQL queries doesn't result in an error?
Tap an option below to answer:

INSERT INTO 
    Students (id, name, age)
VALUES
    ('Jules', 8, 22);
This query will result in an error because the order of values is incorrect. The name value ('Jules') is inserted into the id column, which expects a numeric value.
This query will result in an error because the order of values is incorrect. The name value ('Jules') is inserted into the id column, which expects a numeric value.

INSERT INTO 
    Students (id, name, age)
VALUES
    (8, Jules, 22);
This SQL query results in an error because Jules is not enclosed in quotes. Since Jules is a string, it should be written as 'Jules' or "Jules" to insert it into the name column properly.
This SQL query results in an error because Jules is not enclosed in quotes. Since Jules is a string, it should be written as 'Jules' or "Jules" to insert it into the name column properly.

INSERT INTO 
    Students (id, name, age)
VALUES
    (8, 'Jules', 22);
This SQL query is correct and will not result in an error.
This SQL query is correct and will not result in an error.

INSERT INTO 
    Students (id, name, age)
VALUES
    ('8', 'Jules', 22);
This query will result in an error because the id column is expected to be an integer, but the value '8' is enclosed in quotes, making it a string.
